│ implementation, scalability requirements, and maintenance overhead. Which approach
│ best aligns with your project's needs and constraints?

❯ 1. In-Memory Storage
     Data stored entirely in application memory. Fast access and performance, but no
     persistence between restarts. Ideal for caching, temporary session data, or
     development/testing environments. Simple implementation with minimal overhead.
